id.description: Unique identifier for this change reason. Use as the {id} path parameter on the v2 change order change reason update and delete endpoints.

company_id.description: ID of the company that owns this change reason. Change reasons are configured per company.

change_reason.description: Human-readable label describing why a change order was raised (e.g. Allowance, Client Request).

show_in_select.description: When true, this reason appears in change-reason dropdowns in the UI; when false it is hidden from selection but remains on existing records.

403.description: User does not have permission to access Change Order Change Reasons.
